in_sanskrit.name: Furkhan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Furkhan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the Lord of the Moon. Furkhan is a name derived from the Persian word 'Farokh', meaning 'Lord' and the Arabic word 'Khan', meaning 'Ruler'. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Krishna, who is often depicted as the Moon God and the Lord of the Universe.
